name: REEL/REAL — Deepfake Detector
description: Check a video for synthetic manipulation without leaving your browser.
//host_permissions: The popup uploads the video to the detection server, which is a different
origin from the extension, so it needs explicit permission to reach it.
Only the local dev server is listed. When the backend is deployed, replace
these two entries with the real https:// origin and nothing else — a wide
pattern like https://*/* would make Chrome warn users that the extension
can read data on every site they visit.
